slots.image_prompt: A futuristic tech cover scene on a deep navy to midnight blue gradient background. A luminous sky blue (#2196F3) neural network of interconnected glowing nodes stretches across the frame, with thin cyan (#00E5FF) circuit-like lines weaving through. Abstract streams of flowing light suggest data and code streaming in parallel, some converging into a central bright cluster. Subtle hexagonal grid overlay adds depth. Cool metallic reflections, atmospheric haze, cinematic depth of field. Professional presentation aesthetic, high contrast, no text or lettering anywhere in the image.

An abstract section divider backdrop on a dark slate-blue background. Concentric soft blue glow rings emanate from the center, layered with faint geometric line art — thin intersecting diagonal lines and minimalist polygonal shards in sky blue (#2196F3) and cyan (#00E5FF). Subtle particle dust floats in the depth. The overall mood is calm, focused, and professional, leaving generous negative space in the center for headline text overlay. No words, numbers, or symbols rendered as text.

A tech-inspired chapter transition background with a deep indigo-to-black gradient. Three horizontal bands of glowing sky blue (#2196F3) light streaks run across the lower third, subtly separated by cyan (#00E5FF) accent highlights. Behind them, a faint isometric tech grid recedes into the distance. Floating translucent geometric shapes — cubes and octahedra outlines — drift in the mid-ground, all softly out of focus. Atmospheric, cinematic, with ample dark space at top for title overlay. No text in the image.

An action-oriented dark tech background on a midnight navy base. A luminous path of sky blue (#2196F3) light winds from the lower left upward toward the right, branching into three converging streams that lead to a cluster of glowing cyan (#00E5FF) nodes. The nodes pulse with soft halos, connected by thin filaments of light resembling a decision network. Faint radial grid lines add structure in the far background. The composition feels forward-moving and purposeful, with dark negative space at the top. No text, numbers, or icons.

A closing chapter ambient scene on a deep navy gradient that fades to near-black at the edges. A wide radial burst of sky blue (#2196F3) light emanates from the center, soft and ethereal, with cyan (#00E5FF) highlights catching the edges like a lens flare. Around the center, a sparse constellation of tiny glowing nodes forms a loose circular web, connected by barely visible filaments. The mood is reflective, conclusive, and warm despite the cool palette. Plenty of dark space surrounds the central glow. No text or lettering.
